title: Factoring a map out of a K-flat complex through a K-flat quasi-isomorphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file sites-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma factors a map a : K^bullet -> L^bullet out of a K-flat complex through a K-flat complex N^bullet with a quasi-isomorphism c : N^bullet -> L^bullet and with a homotopic to c composed with b, and it asks in addition that flatness of the terms be preserved (statement lines 3417-3433). The proof works in the homotopy category, where the factorisation is a statement about the distinguished triangle attached to the map and the long exact sequence of homotopy classes (proof lines 3435-3455); it then constructs the auxiliary complex and the maps (proof lines 3455-3465) and refines the construction so that flatness of the terms is inherited (proof lines 3465-3481). The non-formal content is the refinement in the flat case. The claim is H2: a homotopy-theoretic construction with one refinement, both written out.
